opening.text: I'm here because I have pain that came on all of a sudden. It feels tender, stabbing like a knife, and sharp, and I'd rate it a 5 out of 10. It gets worse when I breathe in deeply. I'm also quite short of breath and have been coughing up blood. I've had surgery within the last month, I'm currently taking hormones, and I travelled to North America in the last 4 weeks.
